name: Backend Change Loop
description: Implement backend behavior with contract, security, validation, and code-review gates.
approval_boundaries: Escalate authentication, authorization, or public compatibility changes.
Do not mutate external services without authorization.

phases.name: Backend context
phases.instructions: Map handlers, services, contracts, commands, and trust boundaries.

phases.name: Backend implementation
phases.instructions: Implement the requested backend behavior in small verified slices.

phases.name: Contract tests
phases.instructions: Add or run focused compatibility and contract tests.

phases.name: Contract review
phases.instructions: Review consumer and provider compatibility independently.

phases.name: Security review
phases.instructions: Review trust boundaries, inputs, authorization, and data exposure.

phases.name: Independent validation
phases.instructions: Run focused tests, lint, type checks, and build checks.

phases.name: Code review
phases.instructions: Review the final diff for correctness and regression risk.

phases.name: Backend handoff
phases.instructions: Prepare a review-ready summary with validation and risks.
